_comment: Travel objects (docs/spider-caverns-plan.md section 4). `nodes`: fixed places a player can travel from/to. kind floo = a fireplace of the Floo Network: the player stands within `floo.radius`, opens the Floo window (interact), picks a known fireplace and pays `floo.cost` x `floo.item`; the authority checks distance, item, combat and knowledge, then moves the body through the ordinary transfer (same map or not) to the arrival point `arrive` metres in front of the destination hearth. pos y = 0 on the grounds means 'on the terrain'. yaw (degrees) is the direction the hearth faces (the room side). A fireplace becomes known when its owner first opens it; `known_by_default` are known to every character.

portkey._comment: An old boot that is a Portkey (protocol v21). The owner places it (consumed) and picks a destination; for countdown_s the owner's party members within grab_radius may hold on (interact). When it fires, everyone still holding and still within reach is carried together to the destination (a travel node), set down in a ring `arrive` metres in front of it. Refunded if it cannot fire (nobody left holding, owner gone). Not inside dungeon copies, not mounted, not within combat_lock_s of combat.
